# smplkit_retry_policy (Data Source)

Read a smplkit retry policy by id. Retry policies are account-global — never environment-scoped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smplkit_retry_policy" "aggressive" {
  id = "aggressive-retry"
}

output "aggressive_max_retries" {
  value = data.smplkit_retry_policy.aggressive.max_retries
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The retry-policy key.

### Read-Only

- `backoff` (String) How the wait between retries grows: `exponential` or `fixed`.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `delay_seconds` (Number) The wait before a retry, in seconds.
- `max_delay_seconds` (Number) Ceiling on the wait between retries (exponential backoff only), or null when uncapped.
- `max_retries` (Number) How many times a failed run is retried after the initial attempt (`0` disables retries; maximum 10).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `retry_on` (Attributes) Which failures the policy retries, or null when it retries nothing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retry_on))
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-modified timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Monotonic version counter.

<a id="nestedatt--retry_on"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry_on`

Read-Only:

- `reasons` (List of String) Failure categories the policy retries on (`CONNECTION_ERROR`, `NON_SUCCESS_STATUS`, `TIMEOUT`).
- `statuses` (List of Number) Response status codes the policy retries on.
